content.short: Matcha is the consumer-facing DEX aggregator by 0x Labs, offering best-price token swaps, gasless trading, and limit orders on Mantle.
content.description: Matcha is the consumer-facing DEX aggregator built by 0x Labs  the team behind the widely used 0x Protocol  searching across hundreds of decentralized exchanges and liquidity sources to find the optimal trading route for any token swap. The platform supports gasless trading, limit orders, and cross-chain swaps. As an official 0x Labs product deployed on Mantle, Matcha brings institutional-grade execution quality to retail DeFi users in a clean and accessible interface.
content.meta: Matcha by 0x Labs is a DEX aggregator offering best-price token swaps on Mantle and multiple chains. Discover Matcha on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
